stem:
Omkar compares two statements about last year's fee of $\mathrm{Rs}\,5000$.
Statement 1: This year's fee is $120\%$ of last year's fee.
Statement 2: The fee rose by $20\%$.

Which two claims are correct?

options.text: Statement 1 means this year's fee is $\mathrm{Rs}\,120$ only.
Statement 1 means this year's fee equals last year's fee plus $20\%$ of last year's fee.
Statement 2 also makes this year's fee equal to $120\%$ of last year's fee.
Statement 1 means the fee fell by $20\%$ from last year.

teacher.key_rationale: 120% of the original is the original plus 20% of the original, so Statement 1 and a 20% rise describe the same final amount. Reading 120% as Rs 120 grabs the numerals only. Treating 120% of as a 20% fall reverses increase and decrease.
